description_en: Creates an ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
description_zh: 创建一个云数据库ClickHouse集群
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse create-db-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-version 22.8.5.29 --db-cluster-category Basic --db-cluster-class S8 --db-node-group-count 1 --db-node-storage 100 --db-cluster-network-type VPC --pay-type Prepaid --vpc-id vpc-bp175iuvg8nxqraf20000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1gzt31twhlo0sa50000 --db-node-storage-type CloudESSD_PL2 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBInstance

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query the zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The kernel version. Valid values:

21.8.10.19

22.8.5.29
parameters.name: db_cluster_version

parameters.help_en:
The replica configuration. Valid values:
Basic: single-replica edition.
HighAvailability: double-replica edition
parameters.help_zh:
副本配置，取值说明：

HighAvailability：双副本版
parameters.name: db_cluster_category

    - S16: standard, 16 cores, 64 GB.
    - S32: standard, 32 cores, 128 GB.
    - S64: standard, 64 cores, 256 GB.
    - S80: standard, 80 cores, 384 GB.
    - S104: standard, 104 cores, 384 GB.
Double-replica edition. Valid values:
    - LC20: large storage, 20 cores, 88 GB.
    - LC40: large storage, 40 cores, 176 GB.
    - LC80: large storage, 80 cores, 352 GB.
    - C8: standard, 8 cores, 32 GB.
    - C16: standard, 16 cores, 64 GB.
    - C32: standard, 32 cores, 128 GB.
    - C64: standard, 64 cores, 256 GB.
    - C80: standard, 80 cores, 384 GB.
    - C104: standard, 104 cores, 384 GB.

</props>

parameters.name: db_cluster_class

parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes.
Single-replica edition: valid values: 1 to 48.
Double-replica edition: valid values: 1 to 24
parameters.help_zh:
节点数量。
单副本版，取值范围：1~48。
双副本版，取值范围：1~24
parameters.name: db_node_group_count

parameters.help_en:
The storage capacity per node. Valid values: 100 to 32000. Unit: GB.

The step size is 100 GB
parameters.help_zh:
单节点存储空间，取值范围：100 GB~32000 GB。

步长为100 GB
parameters.name: db_node_storage

parameters.help_en: The network type. Only VPC is supported
parameters.help_zh: 网络类型，目前只支持VPC
parameters.name: db_cluster_network_type

parameters.help_en: The cluster description
parameters.help_zh: 集群描述
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值说明：
Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription type of the subscription cluster. Valid values:
<notice>This parameter takes effect and is required only when PayType is set to Prepaid.></notice>
Year: subscription on a yearly basis.
Month: subscription on a monthly basis
parameters.help_zh:
预付费集群为包年或包月类型，取值说明：
<notice>当付费类型为Prepaid时，该参数才生效且为必填参数。></notice>
Year：包年。
Month：包月
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the subscription cluster.
<notice>This parameter takes effect and is required only when PayType is set to Prepaid.></notice>
If Period is set to Year, valid values: 1 to 3 (integer).
If Period is set to Month, valid values: 1 to 9 (integer)
parameters.help_zh:
预付费集群的购买时长。
<notice>当付费类型为Prepaid时，该参数才生效且为必填参数。></notice>
当Period为Year时，取值范围：1~3（整数）。
当Period为Month时，取值范围：1~9（整数）
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: VPC ID
parameters.help_zh: VPC ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID
parameters.help_zh: 交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is a string that contains up to 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。字符串格式，不超过64个ASCII字符即可
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The storage type. Valid values:
<props="china">- CloudESSD_PL0: PL0 ESSD.</props>
CloudESSD: PL1 ESSD.
CloudESSD_PL2: PL2 ESSD.
CloudESSD_PL3: PL3 ESSD.
CloudEfficiency: ultra cloud disk
parameters.help_zh:
存储类型，取值说明：
<props="china">- CloudESSD_PL0：ESSD PL0云盘。</props>
CloudESSD：ESSD PL1云盘。
CloudESSD_PL2：ESSD PL2云盘。
CloudESSD_PL3：ESSD PL3云盘。
CloudEfficiency：高效云盘
parameters.name: db_node_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the key used for cloud disk encryption. This parameter is required when EncryptionType is set to CloudDisk.

You can view the key ID in the Key Management Service (KMS) console or create a key.
If EncryptionType is not specified, you do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
加密类型为CloudDisk时，该参数为必填参数。

云盘加密的密钥ID。您可以在密钥管理服务控制台查看密钥ID，也可以创建新的密钥。
加密类型为空时，不用填写该参数
parameters.name: encryption_key

parameters.help_en:
The encryption type. Only cloud disk encryption is supported. Set the value to CloudDisk.
If this parameter is not specified, data is not encrypted
parameters.help_zh:
加密类型。目前只支持云盘加密，值为CloudDisk。
不填写该参数时，表示不加密
parameters.name: encryption_type

parameters.help_en:
The backup set ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/360339.html operation to query the backup set ID.
This parameter is required when you restore data for an ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/360339.html接口查询备份集ID。
当云数据库ClickHouse集群进行数据恢复时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The source cluster ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html operation to query the cluster ID.
This parameter is required when you restore data for an ApsaraDB for ClickHouse cluster
parameters.help_zh:
源集群ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170879.html接口查询备份集ID。
当云数据库ClickHouse集群进行数据恢复时，该参数为必填项
parameters.name: source_db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the cluster belongs
parameters.help_zh: 集群所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The secondary zone
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区
parameters.name: zone_id_bak

parameters.help_zh: 备专有网络交换机
parameters.name: vswitch_bak

parameters.help_en: The secondary zone 2
parameters.help_zh: 备可用区2
parameters.name: zond_id_bak_2

parameters.help_en: The secondary vSwitch 2
parameters.help_zh: 备专有网络交换机2

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal.
This parameter takes effect only when PayType is set to Prepaid
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费。
仅在PayType = Prepaid，预付费时生效
